member.name: T:Regalis.API.UtcDateTimeConverter
member.summary: Every DateTime in this system is UTC (A13), but values materialized from SQL Server carry DateTimeKind.Unspecified and would serialize without the Z suffix, which browsers then parse as local time. This converter stamps Unspecified as UTC on the way out and normalizes inbound values to UTC.
